scope.summary: Implement the shared-operator-UX-invariant enforcement harness for STU-UNI-003: across ALL task modes there is ONE selection model (StudioSelectionSet regardless of raster/vector/layout/board context), ONE undo/history surface (14.19), ONE color pipeline (14.8), ONE asset/library surface (Loom - no Studio-private asset silo), and ONE export surface (StudioExportRecipe). A negative test proves no task mode forks a private selection/undo/color/asset/export silo.
acceptance_criteria: ONE selection/undo/color/asset/export across all task modes; private-silo forks rejected
expected_tests: test: selection/undo/color/asset/export resolve to one shared surface across all modes
negative: a mode instantiating a private selection/undo/color/asset/export silo fails the harness

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Unification / Shared UX invariants (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Task modes drift into per-mode silos; unification law broken.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
